ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) disruptions covering approximately 15-20% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment base with high-contrast white linear pixel chains and small circular pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed non-uniformly across both visible lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations with vertical pixel-amplitude variations of 5 to 25 pixels along the visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a gradual convex sweep; right lobe displays a sharp upward convex trajectory terminating in a distinct pointed tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially concentrated high-intensity circular clusters localized at the apex of the right lobe and distributed across the central area of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multidirectional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying thicknesses (2-5 pixels) crisscrossing both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white linear scarring and localized circular barnacle-related lesions are visible across the pigmented surface.
